0524ed00f235.name: Lord of Terror
0524ed00f235.plain: When your opponent takes a Morale test for a unit within 6" of your Warlord, they must roll one extra dice and keep the highest result.

0ac551802ab0.name: Gift of Chaos
0ac551802ab0.plain: If manifested, pick an enemy unit within 6" of the psyker that the psyker can see, and roll a D6. If the roll is higher than that unit's Toughness, it suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. If this power slays a CHARACTER, you may put a new Chaos Spawn into your army: before that character's model is removed, place the Spawn within 1" of it.

0c61f4f7b6c8.name: Self-repair
0c61f4f7b6c8.plain: At the start of each of your turns, roll a D6. On a 6, this unit heals one wound.

102762e68512.name: Mysterious Protection
102762e68512.plain: Cypher has a 4+ invulnerable save. Also, if Cypher is slain, roll a D6. On a 2+, his model is still removed from play, but he doesn't count as slain for any mission victory conditions.

13e26c23e76a.name: Escape
13e26c23e76a.plain: Once per battle, you can take this model off the battlefield at the end of any Fight phase or Shooting phase and put it into Strategic Reserves. If it isn't on the battlefield when the battle ends, it is destroyed.

14c92df4a75e.name: Eternal Vendetta
14c92df4a75e.plain: In the Fight phase, your Warlord can re-roll failed wound rolls for its attacks against targets that have the ADEPTUS ASTARTES keyword.

15cbf70a0db2.name: Blazing Weapons
15cbf70a0db2.plain: Cypher can shoot his pistols in your Shooting phase even if he Advanced or Fell Back earlier that turn.

1693b4ec13a7.name: Unholy Fortitude
1693b4ec13a7.plain: Your Warlord adds 1 to its Wounds characteristic, and each time it loses a wound, roll a dice: on a 6, it shrugs off the damage and keeps that wound.

1afe2285c1a2.name: Diabolic Strength
1afe2285c1a2.plain: If manifested, choose a HERETIC ASTARTES model within 12" of the psyker. Its Strength goes up by 2 and its Attacks go up by 1 until your next Psychic phase starts.

2be946dfae02.name: Hatred Incarnate
2be946dfae02.plain: Your Warlord's attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

3c2a79ca5e33.name: Malicious Volleys
3c2a79ca5e33.plain:
Models in this unit don't use the normal Rapid Fire rules when they fire Rapid Fire bolt weapons. Instead, they make twice as many attacks if at least one of these is true:
• The target is within half the weapon's maximum range.
• The model is INFANTRY, and all models in its unit Remained Stationary during your previous Movement phase.
• The model is a TERMINATOR, BIKER or HELBRUTE.
Here, a Rapid Fire bolt weapon means any bolt weapon of the Rapid Fire type. A bolt weapon is any weapon with the word 'bolt' in its profile (for example boltgun, bolt pistol, combibolter or Inferno boltgun). Bolt weapon rules also apply when you fire the boltgun profile of a combi-weapon, and when you fire an Artefact of Chaos that replaced a bolt weapon (such as Spitespitter). The Talon of Horus also counts as a Rapid Fire bolt weapon.

3f72094808cf.name: The Murder Sword
3f72094808cf.plain: Only a model with a power sword can take this. It replaces that model's power sword.

559986ea1239.name: Infernal Gaze
559986ea1239.plain: If manifested, roll 3 dice for one enemy unit that is visible and within 18" of the psyker. Each 4+ inflicts one mortal wound on that unit.

629d45524732.name: Fallen Angels
629d45524732.plain: When a Fallen unit shoots (firing Overwatch included), you can re-roll its hit rolls of 1, as long as it didn't move in its last Movement phase. Also, a Fallen unit never loses more than 1 model from any one failed Morale test; ignore any losses after the first.

6736a9a19599.name: Smoke Launchers
6736a9a19599.plain: Once per game, in the Shooting phase, this model can use its Smoke Launchers instead of shooting any of its weapons. If it does, until your next Shooting phase your opponent must subtract 1 from every hit roll made with ranged weapons that target this vehicle.

6fe39d097642.name: Daemon Weapon
6fe39d097642.plain: In the Fight phase, the first time this model is chosen to fight that phase, roll one D6. On a 1, it suffers 1 mortal wound and can't use this weapon for the rest of the phase. On a 2+, it fights with this weapon as normal.

7522b6538716.name: The Black Mace
7522b6538716.plain: Only a model with a power maul or accursed crozius can take this. It replaces that model's power maul or accursed crozius.

78eb280ee484.name: Fallen Angels
78eb280ee484.plain:
Lets your army include one Fallen Angels Specialist Detachment: a Vanguard Detachment made up only of FALLEN, Sorcerer and Chaos Rhino units.
Use this Stratagem before the battle, while you are mustering your army.
• Sorcerer units and Chaos Rhinos in this Detachment lose their <MARK OF CHAOS>, HERETIC ASTARTES and <LEGION> Faction keywords and gain the IMPERIUM and FALLEN Faction keywords instead.
• Sorcerer units also swap their Death to the False Emperor ability for the Fallen Angels ability.
• Chaos Rhinos get a new Transport section: each can carry 10 FALLEN INFANTRY models, and can't carry JUMP PACK models.
• Every unit in this Detachment gains the FALLEN ANGELS keyword.

88c7e5e8a19f.name: Flames of Spite
88c7e5e8a19f.plain: Each wound roll of 6+ for a melee weapon attack by your Warlord also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of any other damage.

8ff564ae0bfd.name: Jump Pack Assault
8ff564ae0bfd.plain: When you deploy, if this model has a jump pack, you can keep it high in the skies rather than putting it on the battlefield. It can then assault from above at the end of any of your Movement phases: place it anywhere on the battlefield over 9" away from every enemy model.

99ae1d1c7555.name: Exalted Champion
99ae1d1c7555.plain: Your Warlord adds 1 to its Attacks characteristic.

9ab6d609bc53.name: The Murder Sword
9ab6d609bc53.plain: At the start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins, you must pick one enemy CHARACTER as the target for the model carrying the Murder Sword (it can be a character that hasn't been set up on the battlefield yet). Tell your opponent which character you picked. Each Murder Sword attack that hits that character automatically inflicts a mortal wound on it, instead of the normal damage.

a4ce02299ff6.name: No-one's Puppet
a4ce02299ff6.plain: The Daemonic Ritual ability isn't available to Cypher, despite him having the CHAOS and CHARACTER keywords.

b6133ba69104.name: The Black Mace
b6133ba69104.plain: Each time the Black Mace slays a model, roll a D6. On a 6, that model's unit suffers an extra mortal wound at the end of the phase.

b6d2e4695228.name: Enigmatic Ally
b6d2e4695228.plain: If your army is Battle-forged and one of its CHAOS SPACE MARINES Detachments includes any CHAOS LORD models, you can add CYPHER to that Detachment without him using up an extra Battlefield Role slot.

bb23393fe385.name: Warptime
bb23393fe385.plain: If manifested, choose a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 3" of the psyker. It can make a move right now, as though it were its Movement phase. Each unit can be affected by Warptime no more than once in each Psychic phase.

bce5aca4f1bf.name: Ul'o'cca, The Black Axe
bce5aca4f1bf.plain: Each time you attack with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 4+ also inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target, on top of any other damage.

c049f5d15a47.name: Death Hex
c049f5d15a47.plain: If manifested, choose an enemy unit that is visible and within 12" of the psyker. That unit can't take invulnerable saves until your next Psychic phase starts.

c2db50a07b87.name: Caliban Steel Blade
c2db50a07b87.plain: Each time you attack with this weapon, a wound roll of 6+ gives that attack a Damage characteristic of D6.

c742cc833cce.name: Caliban Steel Blade
c742cc833cce.plain: Only a model with a force sword can take this. It replaces that model's force sword and uses its own profile, shown below.

e25bff239d6a.name: Lord Cypher
e25bff239d6a.plain: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for your FALLEN units while they are within 6" of Cypher.

ea28b66292ee.name: Agent of Discord
ea28b66292ee.plain:
While an enemy unit is within this model's discord range, neither that unit nor its models can use any abilities, Warlord Traits or Relics that would let your opponent gain or get back Command Points.

The discord range depends on how many other FALLEN ANGELS models are within 12" of this model:
• fewer than 10: discord range is 12"
• 10-19: discord range is 18"
• 20 or more: discord range is 24"

fd9205713a1e.name: Prescience
fd9205713a1e.plain: If manifested, pick a HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 18" of the psyker. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, you can add 1 to every hit roll made for that unit.
